verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment of contact and company records is a fair axis for a CRM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents firmographic or contact data enrichment. The nearest items do not qualify: Freddy AI intent scores and the 360° customer view are adjacent features, and the Bulk Upsert Contact API is a developer building block, not enrichment itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
